archetypes.record_predicate: Per-record field-state or timestamp predicate on one task table
archetypes.aggregate_distribution: Count, ratio, share, distribution, dominance or trend over a slice, judged against a threshold
archetypes.configuration_inspection: Reads platform configuration objects and compares them with usage
archetypes.reference_integrity: A reference field must resolve to an existing, active or valid-state target
archetypes.cross_record_linkage: Existence or state of RELATED records in another ITSM table (incident↔problem↔change↔KB, approvals, tasks)
archetypes.relationship_graph: Needs the CMDB relationship graph: degree, traversal to a service, dependent CIs
archetypes.audit_history: Needs sys_audit, journal or task_sla event history to reconstruct transitions or timing
archetypes.text_analysis: Similarity, clustering, normalised-frequency, semantic consistency or pattern (regex) analysis over free text
archetypes.temporal_correlation: Correlates events across records or tables by CI and time window
archetypes.composite: Derives from other rules’ outputs or needs three or more distinct mechanisms in sequence

states.executable: runs once its tables are verified on the instance
states.unconfigured: runs once a threshold the workbook leaves open is set
states.undefined: the workbook leaves part of the detection undefined
states.specification_gap: the workbook does not say enough to evaluate deterministically
states.object_unverified: needs a platform object whose table is not established
states.not_built: fully defined; evaluator not built in this stage
states.equivalent: the same condition as another module's rule, evaluated there
states.derived: the measure IS the module score (Phase 9, CSDM-072)

conventions.tables: the candidate tables a read-only instance validation found present and readable (rules/enterprise_dq/instance-validation.json). Every table a config reads is also in its requires_tables, which the runner verifies on EACH instance before any read.
conventions.product: from the workbook overlay: the Enterprise DQ dimension (Q1–Q7) the rule scores in
